chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 34: The Reincarnation Writ – Ji Ning Learns a Cosmic Secret
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning discovers a golden scroll penned by the Grand Xia Emperor himself—a Reincarnation Writ! Meanwhile, far-off prodigies receive a mysterious call to the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
og_title: The Emperor's Name Echoes Across the Cosmos
og_description: Ji Ning uncovers the terrifying secret of a fallen assassin's treasure, while a slovenly genius dreams of a turtle and a fiery island master hears the call of destiny.
twitter_title: When you find out the Emperor's true name—and he *notices*.
twitter_description: Ji Ning gets a cosmic get-out-of-death-free card, but the price is catching the attention of the most powerful being in the world.

lore_anchors.definition: A sacred scroll personally inscribed by the Grand Xia Emperor. It guarantees that upon the bearer's death, their soul will be protected and sent back to be reborn in their original clan and world, bypassing the normal judgment of the Ten Kings of Hell.

The founder and eternal ruler of the Grand Xia Dynasty, named Xiamang Sun. He ended the Fiendgod Era and has ruled this major world for billions of years. His true name is known to very few, and speaking it allows him to perceive the speaker.

A terrifyingly powerful Earth Immortal of the Void stage residing on Suncrow Island in the North Sea. He possesses the ancient Suncrow bloodline, giving him power nearly comparable to a Celestial Immortal.

The number one third-generation disciple of the Black-White College, known for his slovenly appearance and love of lazy cultivation. He has mastered the 'Black Tortoise Grand Divine Ability' and receives a mysterious premonition about the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.

A legendary divine ability based on the Xuanwu (Black Tortoise), one of the Four Symbols of Daoist mythology. It grants immense defensive power and deadly offensive potential, manifesting as a Turtle-Snake phantom.
A rare and powerful ancient bloodline that grants its possessor incredible combat potential, comparable to a Celestial Immortal even while still at the Void stage.
